scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @board/shared build && pnpm db:generate && pnpm --parallel --filter @board/web --filter @board/api dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @board/shared build && pnpm db:generate && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test:cov: pnpm --filter @board/shared build && pnpm db:generate && pnpm -r test:cov
scripts.db:seed: pnpm --filter @board/shared build && pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @board/api db:seed
